Resolves the MIME type locally via mime.lookup on the file extension and returns a match boolean; no API call and no state touched.
Turns a string into a file only via files.write into the flow's own file store — an AP-internal sink, which the wave-2 ruling says is not external state; no external system is written.
Returns file.filename from the input file property; fixed in-flow read of a known value, no mutation.
Decodes the input file's buffer to text or base64 and returns it; specific known resource, no query and no mutation.

Compresses input files in-process and returns the archive via context.files.write only; pure in-flow transform with an AP-internal sink, no external system touched.
